sources.title: FixtureSwap says attackers drained $4.2 million from its pools
sources.excerpt: FixtureSwap said attackers drained $4.2 million from its liquidity pools on Sunday, according to a statement posted by the project.

sources.title: Incident update
sources.excerpt: Our preliminary review indicates a compromised deployer key was used to upgrade the pool contract. The investigation is ongoing and figures may change.

sources.title: Alert: FixtureSwap outflows
sources.excerpt: Example Security Lab flagged outflows of about 1,400 ETH from FixtureSwap pools to a newly funded address. The funds were later bridged to another network.
